The '''Mounted MPTL 17''' was a compact model of [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launcher manufactured by [[Bryn & Gweith]]. It was designed for anti-vehicle use. Several were installed in armored turrets at [[Fortress Keremark]].<ref name="HS" />
